intro: Designed to keep up with your workflow, the Bay workdesk blends style with function. Whether you’re studying, working, or creating, it gives you the space to focus—without the clutter.

features.title: Effortless organization with overhead storage
features.text: Features a sleek, partitioned sliding shutter for convenient, dust-free storage, keeping your workspace neat and essentials within reach​.

features.title: All-in-one storage for a clutter-free space
features.text: Integrated shelves and compartments provide abundant storage for documents, gadgets, and office supplies, helping you stay organised effortlessly​.

features.title: Tidy workspace with smart cable management
features.text: Smart cable routing ensures wires remain tangle-free and out of sight, creating a clean, distraction-free desk environment​.

features.title: Swivel pull-out arm for extra workspace
features.text: Equipped with a swivel arm that extends smoothly, offering additional workspace for writing, drawing, or multitasking with ease.

features.title: Spacious surface for uninterrupted workflow
features.text: Generous desk space accommodates your laptop, books, and other essentials, giving you room to work comfortably and efficiently​.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
